_comment: Optional per-project config. Place at project root as guardian.config.json. All fields are optional — auto-detection is used for anything not specified.

searchHint._comment: Nudge Claude toward the semantic `search` tool when it greps. enabled: on/off; rearmAfter: grep searches without a semantic search before re-nudging; stalenessThreshold: changed files since last index build before suggesting a rebuild.
